github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Write a single concise commit subject line in imperative mood, max 72 characters. Always start with a Conventional Commits type prefix followed by a colon and a space. Allowed types: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, chore, revert. This repository is PythonAwsBedrockAgentCoreCarMarketplace: a demo of a car marketplace AI sales assistant on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, with a LangGraph agent on AgentCore Runtime, a tool exposed through AgentCore Gateway backed by an AWS Lambda that reads MongoDB Atlas, sample data, a GitHub Actions pipeline that pushes the agent image to Amazon ECR, and a step-by-step tutorial. Add a scope in parentheses identifying the affected part of THIS repo, chosen from: agent (the LangGraph agent container under agent/), lambda (the search_cars Lambda tool under lambda/), data (the sample stores/cars data and the seed script under data/), scripts (helper scripts under scripts/ such as build_and_push.sh and invoke_runtime.py), docs (the tutorial and other documentation under docs/), ci (the GitHub Actions workflow under .github/workflows), repo (cross-cutting repository config such as .gitignore, .vscode, README). When a change spans more than one scope, join them with a plus sign, e.g. fix(agent+lambda):. Do not add a body, bullet points, or explanatory paragraphs. Do not add a Co-Authored-By footer or any trailer. Summarize only the essence of the change. Only add a short body if the change is genuinely complex and cannot be conveyed in the subject alone.
